items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Well that time we had Big Yank, trombone player.

ctx.x: And do you remember any of the other guys with Howard?
Well that time we had Big Yank, trombone player. And Yank left to go with Allen. And he got Big Fire in the Yanks' place.
